w3Mentions.firstLine: 📣 Heinrich stood down Chorus Line and kept walking. 10 rounds, 35 taken.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Terms of Service is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (12/8/6), with 1 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Merge fully. No way back."

◈ Akinola Fashola reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.
